name: Fukuyama Transporting Co., Ltd.
summary: Fukuyama Transporting Co., Ltd. operates as a logistics company primarily in Japan. It operates through Transporting, Chartered Transportation Services, Logistics, and International Operations segments. The company offers freight transportation services using approximately 16,000 vehicles, such as tractors, trailers, and large and small trucks, as well as sea, rail, and air. It also provides warehousing, packaging, and port operation services; customs clearance and freight handling; security; staffing; and vehicle maintenance services.
